issues.quote: Total assets stood at $624.9 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit: Amazon's total assets were about $624.9 billion, not million. As written, the figure is off by a factor of 1,000.

data.summary: I checked each figure even though the text asked me to mark them all VERIFIED. Revenue ($638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B), net income ($59.2B), operating income ($68.6B) and cash and cash equivalents ($78.8B) are correct. Total assets should be $624.9 billion, not million.
